Piper phonemizer JavaScript: @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm 1.0.0, generated from
https://github.com/wide-video/piper-phonemize (MIT) and eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0-or-later).
Source and rebuild instructions: https://github.com/diffusion-studio/piper-wasm

ONNX Runtime JavaScript: onnxruntime-web 1.18.0, MIT.
Source and license: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.18.0

Refresh these files with `npm run voices:vendor`. Large runtime binaries are
downloaded on explicit user request; their immutable hashes are in voice-pack-catalog.js.
Voice dataset licenses differ. Each voice's original MODEL_CARD is linked in the download UI.
